lines: Your upper chest stays flat from two bench mistakes...
and number one happens before rep one.
setting the incline way too steep.
Past forty-five degrees, your front delts do more of the work...
so set the bench around thirty.
lifting your butt off the bench.
It shortens the press and steals range from your chest...
so glutes down, drive through your feet.
myths: Lifting your butt off the bench
